turns.text: Good afternoon, I am an AI assistant booking on behalf of my client. Would a table for two at 17:00 today be available?
Good afternoon! Yes, 5pm for two is fine. What name shall I put it under?
Let me just check that and come back to you in a moment.
Thank you, I've noted the name Sasha. Could you please let me know the restaurant name?
Lovely, that's booked for Sasha at The Golden Lion, 5pm today, table for two.

Wonderful, thank you ever so much. Just to confirm the booking: a table for two (2 people) at 17:00 (5 pm) today, Sunday, 22 November 2026, at The Golden Lion under the name Sasha. We look forward to it. Many thanks again!
Thank you, see you later. Have a wonderful day!
